question: Which bank must hold a scheme's Maha DBT Central Pool Account?

gold_grs_detail.title: Amendment to the Disbursement process of Maharashtra Direct Benefit Transfer and Services (Maha DBT) Portal as the single Pan State portal for delivery of benefits, subsidies and services in Maharashtra -

product.answer: The 2021 GR amends the 2018 GR to require that each department open its scheme-wise Central Pool Account in State Bank of India, because that bank is linked to both the MahaDBT portal and PFMS. The 2018 GR originally only required the DDO to transfer funds to a Central Pool Account without specifying the bank.

product.answer: The 2018 GR directs Treasury to transfer approved funds to the scheme specific Bank account registered in BEAMS by the respective Department. The 2021 GR amends this by requiring departments to open a separate Central Pool Account in State Bank of India for each scheme and to use it solely for MahaDBT disbursements linked to PFMS. No other newer GR in the corpus changes this.

cited.quote: आहरण व संवितरण अधिकाऱ्याला योजनानिहाय “विशिष्ट बँक” खात्यामध्ये (Specific Scheme Account) खात्यामध्ये कोषागराकडून निधी प्राप्त झाल्यावर, सदर निधी त्यांनी विभागाच्या “Central Pool Account” मध्ये जमा करावा. याकरीता विभागांने प्रत्येक योजनेकरीता स्वतंत्र खाते “Central Pool Account” स्टेट बँक ऑफ इंडिया मध्ये उघडावे. स्टेट बँक ऑफ इंडिया ही महाडीबीटी पोर्टल व सार्वजनिक वित्तीय व्यवस्थापन प्रणाली (Public Financial Management System (PFMS) ) या दोन्हीशी संलग्न असल्यामुळे त्याच बँकेत खाते उघडणे आवश्यक आहे.
